description: Unit tests for skia convolution functions, including impulse response, image halving, filter addition, SIMD verification, and Gaussian convolution setup.

classes.name: ConvolutionFilter1D
classes.description: Represents a 1D convolution filter with methods for adding filters and retrieving filter data.

methods.name: FillImpulseFilter
methods.description: Fills a convolution filter with impulse functions for the range 0 to num_entries.

methods.name: TestImpulseConvolution
methods.description: Tests that convolving with an impulse filter does not change the data.

methods.name: FillBoxFilter
methods.description: Fills a filter with a box filter averaging every two pixels.

methods.name: VerifySIMD
methods.description: Verifies SIMD optimized convolution produces the same result as non-SIMD.

methods.name: SetUpGaussianConvolutionKernel
methods.description: Sets up a Gaussian convolution kernel for smoothing or gradient filters.
